introduction.applicationPrefix: This accessibility statement applies to the SPARK Workflow application published at
introduction.legalBasis: As a public body within the meaning of Directive (EU) 2016/2102, we endeavour to make our websites and mobile applications accessible in accordance with the provisions of the Federal Disability Equality Act (BGG) and the Accessible Information Technology Ordinance (BITV 2.0), which implements Directive (EU) 2016/2102.

conformance.heading: Compliance Status
conformance.requirements: The accessibility requirements arise from §§ 3 paragraphs 1 to 4 and 4 of BITV 2.0, issued on the basis of § 12d BGG.
conformance.review: Compliance with the requirements was reviewed in May 2026 on the basis of the statutory requirements and global standards (EN 301 549, BITV 2.0).
conformance.result: Based on the review, the website is partially compliant with the aforementioned requirements due to the following exceptions.
conformance.exceptionsIntro: As of 25 May 2025, the following content is not yet fully accessible:

exceptions.visualHeadings: Some visually recognizable headings have not been marked up as headings.
exceptions.lists: Some lists have not been marked up as lists.
exceptions.formLabels: Some form fields do not have a technically associated label.
exceptions.autocomplete: Technical completion aids are not sufficiently supported (autocomplete function).
exceptions.textContrast: The contrast between text and background color is sometimes insufficient.
exceptions.graphicContrast: The contrast requirements for graphical content are sometimes not met.
exceptions.zoom: After increasing the text size with the browser zoom function, some website content and functions cannot be used.
exceptions.skipLinks: The page structure is not fully represented by skip links or other mechanisms for bypassing areas.
exceptions.keyboardFocus: When navigating by keyboard, the focus is sometimes not clearly visible or not visible at all.
exceptions.keyboardScreenreaderControls: Some functions and controls cannot be operated as expected with the keyboard or screen reader (e.g. editor, document directory).
exceptions.timeLimit: There is a time limit that cannot be extended or deactivated.
exceptions.formErrorsDetectable: Error messages in forms cannot be identified by assistive technologies.
exceptions.formErrorsPersistent: Error messages in forms disappear before the errors have been corrected.
exceptions.controlNameRoleValue: For some controls, the required information on name, role, or value cannot be identified by assistive technologies.
exceptions.pdf: Not all PDF documents are accessible.

reason.heading: Reason
reason.text: The “SPARK Workflow” application is currently under development. We are actively working on the known barriers. Some of the listed content may already have been resolved at this point. We endeavour to remove all barriers for people with disabilities as quickly as possible.

feedback.text: Have you noticed deficiencies in the accessibility of content? Or do you have questions about accessibility? Please feel free to contact us:

creation.heading: Creation Date
creation.text: This statement was created on 26 May 2026.

arbitration.heading: Arbitration Procedure
arbitration.text1: If no satisfactory solution is found after your feedback to the contact named above, you can contact the arbitration service under § 16 BGG. The BGG arbitration service supports out-of-court dispute resolution in conflicts concerning accessibility between people with disabilities and federal public bodies. The arbitration procedure is free of charge. Legal counsel is not required.
arbitration.text2Prefix: Further information on the arbitration procedure and application options is available at:
